name: TranslationJob
description: Platform-side mirror of one lecture's run through the off-LAN translation pipeline (Codex foreman/worker → HeyGen → stitch → publish). The external foreman/worker POSTs status updates to a Base44 backend function which upserts this record; the Admin 'Translation' tab renders it as a Foreman Dashboard.

lecture_id.description: Id of the Lecture this job translates.

lecture_code.description: Source code, e.g. L09 (maps to Lecture_09.mp4).

worker_id.description: Which Codex CLI worker is handling it.

status.description: Current pipeline stage (mirrors the worker's 5 steps + publish).

retries.description: How many times a stage was retried.

last_error.description: Most recent error message, if any.

output_url.description: Stitched English file URL (becomes Lecture.video_en_source on publish).

youtube_url.description: Optional public YouTube URL for the translated lecture.
